Select molecule_chembl_id aliased as compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Filter where target_dictionary.pref_name exactly equals 'tyrosine-protein kinase JAK2' and assays.assay_organism equals 'Homo sapiens'. Inner join compound_structures on molregno to require canonical_smiles. Return all matching rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
